punchline: Sapolsky answers the question of why he did it with causes that run from one second before the act back to years before it.
thirty_sec: Sapolsky asks why a person committed one violent act and answers on several clocks: one second before, the brain; minutes before, what they sensed; hours before, hormones; years before, childhood and culture. All are true at once, he says, and the one we pick shapes how we judge.
